items.value: Your release administrator supplies and verifies prthak-controller-0.17.0.tar.gz using independently trusted release identity. A source ZIP is not the installation archive. An approved graphical file-transfer tool can copy it to your Linux home folder.

scp /PATH/TO/prthak-controller-0.17.0.tar.gz \
  YOUR_USER@CONTROLLER_IP:
items.label: On your laptop - replace the path, user and address

items.value: ssh YOUR_USER@CONTROLLER_IP
items.label: Open the controller terminal

items.value:
sudo install -d -o root -g root -m 0755 /opt/prthak/releases
sudo tar --no-same-owner --no-same-permissions \
  -xzf "$HOME/prthak-controller-0.17.0.tar.gz" \
  -C /opt/prthak/releases
cd /opt/prthak/releases/prthak-controller-0.17.0
items.label: Extract the verified archive into a protected release folder

items.value: Now run the one installer command in Step 3. It prepares missing dependencies automatically. Root/sudo, systemd and working approved repositories are required. No Git or manual .env file is needed.

controller.title: Plan capacity and confirm installation
controller.subtitle: Reference sheet | CPU, memory and completion

items.value: 20-server pilot: start with 4 vCPU, 8 GiB RAM, 80 GiB OS/Docker disk and a separate 100 GiB data SSD. These are VM allocations, not constant CPU or memory consumption.

5,000 servers: begin with 8 vCPU / 16 GiB per management-only controller. A combined database voter starts at 8 vCPU / 32 GiB, 80 GiB OS/Docker and 300 GiB data SSD. Managed database HA needs three eligible voters and real fencing.

Actual utilization depends on policy size, discovery, traffic learning, retention and site latency. The previous 0.16 capacity benchmark is historical evidence; these new installers do not create a fresh 5,000-server performance measurement.

sudo systemctl status prthak-appliance-manager.service --no-pager
sudo docker ps
items.label: Optional read-only checks - ask your server team if needed

items.value: GUI completion: trusted HTTPS opens, the temporary password was changed, and controller readiness is healthy. Then install the first agent and confirm its heartbeat before the rest of the pilot.
Native OS, live firewalld/rollback, DC/DR and actual pilot acceptance remain pending. See the detailed VM and capacity runbooks for connection budgeting and failover sizing.

agent.title: Optional: copy the package and setup
agent.subtitle: Transfer sheet | Before Step 6

items.value: Your release administrator verifies the signed 0.17.0 agent archive for the CPU. Use amd64 for x86_64 or arm64 for aarch64. The GUI supplies the private prthak-agent-setup.json. Keep it private.

scp /PATH/TO/prthak-agent-0.17.0-linux-amd64.tar.gz \
  /PATH/TO/prthak-agent-setup.json YOUR_USER@SERVER_IP:
items.label: On your laptop - example for AMD64; use arm64 if required

items.value: ssh YOUR_USER@SERVER_IP
items.label: Open the endpoint terminal

items.value:
sudo install -o root -g root -m 0600 \
  "$HOME/prthak-agent-setup.json" /root/prthak-agent-setup.json
sudo install -d -o root -g root -m 0755 /opt/prthak/agent-releases
sudo tar --no-same-owner --no-same-permissions \
  -xzf "$HOME/prthak-agent-0.17.0-linux-amd64.tar.gz" \
  -C /opt/prthak/agent-releases
cd /opt/prthak/agent-releases/prthak-agent-0.17.0-linux-amd64
items.label: Protect and extract - AMD64 example; substitute arm64 in both paths

items.value: Then run the one universal command in Step 6. Your minimal OS must already supply tar/file-transfer tools to unpack media; an approved deployment tool can perform that step. Runtime dependencies are installed by Prṛthak. Do not edit the JSON.

agent.title: Agent footprint and completion checks
agent.subtitle: Reference sheet | Package, CPU and memory

items.value: Package: one static Go binary per CPU, its systemd unit, signed manifests and install scripts. There is no separately installed Go, Python or Git runtime. RPM/DEB packages are optional inert payload delivery; the GUI kit and installer activate the agent.

Planning allowance: start with 128 MiB for ordinary monitoring/helpers or 256 MiB during learning. These are allowances to evaluate, not enforced limits. Current release CPU/memory must be measured in the pilot.

Historical passive baseline: an older Linux ARM64 fixture measured roughly 10-13 MiB agent RSS, about 57 MiB sampled with helper processes, and 0.22% of one core after startup including helpers. This excludes firewalld, kernel sets and capture load; it is not a current-release guarantee.

sudo systemctl status seg-agent.service --no-pager
sudo /usr/local/bin/seg-agent \
  --config /etc/seg-agent/config.json --status
items.label: Optional read-only checks - installation is complete only after review

items.value: In Servers, confirm this hostname/IP, fresh heartbeat, OS version and discovered services. A completed file copy does not prove a successful authenticated report. Reuse the same valid fleet setup for the other endpoints; each creates a unique identity.
